metabolic_screening.state_form_note: PA has a standalone 'Refusal of Newborn Screening Form' (Rev. January 2025). Covers DBS, CCHD, and hearing screening. Religious exemption available. Every baby born in PA is required to have DBS, CCHD, and hearing screening 24-48h after birth; parents can refuse if against religious beliefs or practices.
